name: Customer Details report
sql_query:
SELECT
    c.Code                                                   AS customer_code,
    c.name                                                   AS customer_name,
    c.NIC                                                    AS nic,
    c.phone,
    REPLACE(REPLACE(c.address, '\r', ''), '\n', ', ')        AS address,
    DATE(c.created_at)                                       AS registered_date,
    COALESCE(s.invoices, 0)                                  AS sales_invoices,
    COALESCE(s.sales_value, 0)                               AS sales_value,
    COALESCE(h.agreements, 0)                                AS hp_agreements,
    COALESCE(h.active_agreements, 0)                         AS active_hp,
    COALESCE(h.hp_value, 0)                                  AS hp_value,
    COALESCE(s.sales_value, 0) + COALESCE(h.hp_value, 0)     AS total_business,
    c.advance_balance,
    NULLIF(GREATEST(COALESCE(s.last_invoice, '1900-01-01'), COALESCE(h.last_agreement, '1900-01-01')), '1900-01-01') AS last_purchase_date
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_code, COUNT(*) AS invoices, SUM(Net_Amount) AS sales_value, MAX(Invoice_date) AS last_invoice
    FROM t_invoice_sums
    WHERE BC = :bc
    GROUP BY customer_code
) s ON s.customer_code = c.Code
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT customer_code,
           COUNT(*) AS agreements,
           SUM(status = 'active') AS active_agreements,
           SUM(net_amount) AS hp_value,
           MAX(invoice_date) AS last_agreement
    FROM t_hire_purchase_sums
    WHERE BC = :bc
    GROUP BY customer_code
) h ON h.customer_code = c.Code
WHERE c.BC = :bc
  AND (:registered_from IS NULL OR DATE(c.created_at) >= :registered_from)
  AND (:registered_to   IS NULL OR DATE(c.created_at) <= :registered_to)
  AND (:search IS NULL OR c.Code    LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                       OR c.name    LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                       OR c.NIC     LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                       OR c.phone   LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%')
                       OR c.address LIKE CONCAT('%', :search, '%'))
ORDER BY c.Code;
